requirements.text: SEQUENCING (amended by source-002 'lets first update cli the looop so opus 5.5 can be usd'): R002 (CLI update), R003 (model verification), and R004 (loop worker pins) execute NOW, mid-wave, ahead of the T072-T076 wave completions - the CLI update does not affect the running session and the three loop lanes are idle. R005 (the main orchestrator's own restart onto Opus 5.5) still waits for the in-flight waves/accepts to reach a clean D-070 finished seam; the waves are never abandoned mid-review. Original message-2 sequencing ('Yes finish first' for ALL steps) is superseded by source-002 for R002-R004 only.
requirements.required_harness: R002-R004: executable now (source-002); their own evidence rows. R005: ledger shows T072-T076 accepted (or owner-dispositioned) before the restart handoff is written.
requirements.required_evidence: Ledger accept records / state.json totals at the R005 seam; the source-002 amendment for the R002-R004 release.
requirements.status_reason: Amended: R002-R004 released to execute mid-wave; R005 still seam-gated.

requirements.text: UPDATE THE CLAUDE CODE CLI ('we need to update the CLI's um, Claude Code because it's on a later version'): update the owner's Claude Code CLI installation to the latest released version. This is owner tooling, not a repository dependency; the repo dependency-security policy's registry gates do not apply, but the update outcome (old version, new version, command used) is recorded in the handoff.
requirements.required_harness: Version check before and after the update command.
requirements.required_evidence: Recorded before/after `claude --version` (or equivalent) output in the seam handoff/report.

requirements.text: VERIFY THE MODEL EXISTS ('a new model that just came out ... It's called Opus 5.5'): after the CLI update, verify the exact Opus 5.5 model identifier from tool-side evidence (CLI model listing/selector, runtime metadata, or official release notes) - NEVER from a model's self-report (the B-024/D-060 rule). If no Opus 5.5 model is exposed by the updated CLI, STOP: report the observed model list to the owner and take no pin flip; do not substitute a different model without a new owner decision.
requirements.required_harness: Tool-side model listing at the updated version.
requirements.required_evidence: The observed exact model id string and where it was read from, recorded in the seam handoff/report.

requirements.text: FLIP THE LOOP WORKER PINS ('update the, the loop so it uses the new Opus 5.5 the same effort setting X high'): point the supervisor loop worker model pin at the verified Opus 5.5 id with x-high effort in all three controller lanes (C:\SupervisorController, C:\SupervisorController2, C:\SupervisorController3). The worker-pin flip is owner-only under controller S3.2 rule 6; THIS DIRECTIVE IS THE OWNER AUTHORIZATION. If the approval classifier blocks the config write, retry ONCE citing D-085 (the D-053/D-055 capture-then-retry-once arc); if still blocked, return the exact one-line edit per lane to the owner and record a blocker - never hammer or bypass. No launch probe is required for an initial pin (B-024 finding). Reviewer/subagent pins are NOT in scope: D-064's opus-4-8 xhigh subagent pin stands unless the owner says otherwise.
requirements.required_harness: The three config diffs (or the owner-executed one-line edits) at the seam.
requirements.required_evidence: Per-lane config before/after content or the recorded blocker with the exact edits.

requirements.text: MAIN-ORCHESTRATOR SWITCH VIA RESTART ('test it out for the main orchestrator ... I would like to switch it'): the running session cannot change its own model; prepare a D-070 finished-seam handoff naming Opus 5.5 x-high as the next session's model so the OWNER restarts the main orchestrator on it. Frame it as a TRIAL of the D-064 main-model pin (fable-5), amending that pin for the trial session(s); D-064 remains the recorded fallback if the owner ends the trial. Give the owner the exact launch step in simple English.
requirements.required_harness: Seam handoff (docs/SESSION_HANDOFF.md) carrying the switch instructions and evidence of R002-R004.
requirements.required_evidence: The handoff content + the owner-facing launch line.
